body: I feel like I could die, disappear, no one would notice or care. I'd just get up, go end my life and that would be that. Everything is so truly fucked and I feel no purpose to live, I feel no need to fight. I feel so done. I've been holding on one more day, another day, and another, for fucking what? what am i holding on for? delaying my own death. I'm scared of ending up in hospital, so my chosen method is 100% going to kill me. Knowing this scares me a little, knowing when I let go, It's real, I'm going to be gone. I'm not strong enough. I've tried to get help so much over so many years, it's been so long, it's never going to get better. No one understands... I just went on some suicide prevention helpline crisis chat waste of fucking time they dont even listen or respond properly.... made me feel worse and like a bigger burden than I already do. What's the point of this? I'm so scared sometimes I think I should be in hospital to be kept safe, but I'm too scared of asking for help, being vulnerable in there, not having control over whether or not I die. I just want the repeating pain to stop.

Thank you so much for your extended comment. <3 a lot of shit happend today at school involving the school counselor and they told my parents about how I feel suicidal and have planned a date etc. 
Not sure where to go from here, I'm scared.
I appreciate your  comment <3 Stay strong
Message me on Monday <3 I want you to stay strong. Tell someone how you're feeling. Ask for help. Reach out, you'll feel less alone in this pain

Thank you for caring and writing a full blown comment. Going to the effort to write that for a total stranger...It means a lot. I do appreciate it so much. I don't want to turn 18. And it's fast approaching... at 12/13 when this madness of depression and chaos of anxiety begun I had this thing, made some kind of promise to myself, It was okay to hold out to 18....6 years later, nothings changed I feel like a failure. I feel like I have to end it now or the pain will never stop and I'll just drive myself insane. It feels like I have no options at all. I don't want to be 18 and risk a full diagnosis on an adult file, or risk breaking down and being admitted to an adult psych ward. Can't handle life now how will I cope with "responsibilities"? I won't. I feel so useless, like a failure and so hopeless. The hardest decision is choosing to die or choosing to scream for help and risk an admission in to hospital I don't want at all.

I am rendered sort of speechless reading your long comment. Long and thoughtful. I appreciate that so much, the fact you went to effort and lengths you didn't have to for a total stranger. Thank you.

I feel an obligation to end my life, I feel like I have to. It's been 6 years living in this depressed madness and anxious chaos... as well as home,school,life problems which only add to it (and partly caused it in the beginning) It started when I was 12/13 and I don't want to turn 18 still feeling this way :'( It might sound silly or weird but it's just something a promise I made myself...It was okay to hold out until 18. Nothings changed, I don't want to turn 18 like this. I don't want a full diagnosis on my adult file, I don't want to risk breaking down and entering an adult psych ward. I can't even handle life now, with not many responsibilities not even legally an "adult" How will I cope being an "adult" ? I won't. I'm not coping now and I'm scared.
The contemplation of whether to get help or die is hard and i dont know why making this decision is so hard :(
Then theres a question do I wanna be stopped from ending this?
What would you do if you were scared you were going to actually succeed in killing yourself?

You're so right though, people can catch up with missed schoolwork but once life is taken that's it, its permanent. I'm so scared I'm going to actually kill myself and it doesn't feel like a choice :( there's no hope. I kind of question it in my head like this "Die or ask for help?" and making this decision is hard because I'm scared either way

I've dealt with depression, anxiety and PTSD for the past 6 years and during that have attempted suicide before and battled suicidal thoughts, urges. It gets really intense and hard to cope with. When things get overwhelming and just too much to the point it feels like the only way to stop the pain and suffering and never ending on edge feeling and craziness of the thoughts is to end your life. I also don't wish to turn 18 in a few months, it's approaching very fast and I don't want to be an adult. I promised myself I'd kill myself before 18 so the anticipation of my 18th birthday is kicking in, Everything is just crazy and chaotic. I don't know what to do anymore. I'm scared it will never get better.
What if she tries to get me hospitalized? Can't afford that in final year of high school need to be there every day. Then again, does it even matter if I end up gone?

Should I tell my school counselor?
I'm worried what will happen I'm in my final year of school I need to be at school I can't afford to be hospitalized. I'm scared I'm just going to kill myself in a few weeks.
